items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: So (Bashey?) played with us that night. He sat in with the band.

ctx.x: I'll put it on tape for you, it's quite amusing.

I wish you would. Boy when I begged to Nick (Boyd Denicke) who (Bashey?) was, you know? So (Bashey?) played with us that night. He sat in with the band. And Nick told me he says, I don't like that fish horn. Get that fish horn out of here. Say I don't like it. So finally, (Bashey?) and the Spirits of Rhythm and myself we went back into Nick's. And of course old Nick had found out just who (Bashey?) was, see? Because at that time old (Bashey?) had him a pressing shop. He wasn't doing nothing you know. And boy, we…
I said, get him out of there.
